messages:
Anika Patel: Heads up—uploaded a compact vs detailed Billing card exploration. Main decision: do we prioritize compact glanceability (single row per project with sparkline + cost) or a rich table (sortable, filterable, invoice links)?
Jordan Rivera: Compact wins for dashboard top-of-fold. Most users want quick signal. We can surface a "See detailed billing" CTA that expands to full table.
Priya Nair: Agree on compact default but the compact row needs clear affordances: hover to reveal invoice/download, and an ellipsis menu for export.
Leo Chung: Implementation caveat: hover controls don't work on touch. We need persistent action buttons on mobile (stacked under each row).
Anika Patel: Good point. So desktop = hover-reveal; mobile = visible secondary actions. Also question: timeline selector default = last 30 days or billing cycle? Product suggestion: default to billing cycle to match invoice totals.
Jordan Rivera: Default to billing cycle makes sense for finance-minded users. Add a small "Last 30 days" quick toggle for troubleshooting.
Priya Nair: Copy nit for the toggle: use labels "Billing cycle" and "Last 30 days" rather than "30d" to aid clarity and a11y.
Leo Chung: Accessibility: compact rows must include aria-labels summarizing project name + cost + % of org spend. Example aria-label: "Project Atlas, $1,234.56, 22% of org spend".
Anika Patel: Export UX: customers asked for both "Daily totals" CSV and "Raw call logs". Want to gate raw logs behind role. How to surface in compact view?
Jordan Rivera: Add an export button in top-right of Billing card with a dropdown: "Export daily totals (CSV)", "Request raw call log". When raw requested, show a toast and enqueue generation.
Priya Nair: Microcopy for the toast: "Raw call log requested. We’ll email you a download link when ready (may take a few minutes)." Keep short.
Leo Chung: For the detailed table, include column for "tokens (est)" and another for "billed tokens" if we can compute it. If billed tokens unavailable immediately, show a "--" with tooltip explaining latency.
Anika Patel: UX for billed vs estimated tokens: do we show both side-by-side or a single column with hover breakdown?
Jordan Rivera: Side-by-side clutters. Use single column "Tokens (est)" and a small info icon that expands to show billed tokens and rounding note.
Priya Nair: Copy for the tooltip: "Estimated tokens = prompt + response. Billed tokens are rounded per our billing policy and may lag by up to 24 hours."
Leo Chung: Visual suggestion: compact row includes a 3-color miniature bar showing prompt vs response vs cache hits. Very small but gives signal. Ensure color contrast and add text alternatives.
Anika Patel: Hmm might be too noisy. Maybe only show breakdown on hover/expand. Keep compact simple.
billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice generation succeeded for Org Redwood Labs, invoice #INV-2026-03-12, total $12,345.67.
Jordan Rivera: Slight UX detail: invoices link should open in a modal with download and share options instead of navigating away. Keeps users in context.
Priya Nair: Modal is good. But provide a permalink too for linking in tickets.
Leo Chung: Performance: lazy-load the detailed table and use skeleton rows for quick perceived load.
Anika Patel: Accessibility final checklist items: keyboard-only interactions for expand/collapse, visible focus for row actions, table headers with scope=col, and CSV export buttons with aria-labels.
Jordan Rivera: Approve the compact default woodframe. I'll update Figma and include mobile variants + the invoice modal.
Priya Nair: I'll finalize copy strings: toggle labels, toast, tooltip.
Leo Chung: I'll add the ARIA snippets to the component doc and mock skeleton states.
Anika Patel: I'll schedule a 15-min review after updates. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
